summary: The flowchart titled 'Identification through database search' illustrates the process of identifying records through a database search with queries and recency filter, resulting in 730 records identified (n=730). After removing duplicates, the count remains at 730. All 730 records were screened, leading to the exclusion of 616 records. A total of 114 full-text articles were assessed for eligibility, with 50 articles excluded for being irrelevant to the definition of an AI agent. Ultimately, 64 studies were included in the review.
